programs.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
programs.desc: More super special places to go - with a mountain retreat, a ghostly inn in Rye, a Brutalist classic, a working lighthouse that's also a hotel, and a pod for a digital detox.

programs.title: Location, Location, Location
programs.desc: Emily and Lucy are spoilt for choice when Kirstie gives them multiple options near the Leeds hospital where they work. And Sarah and Tom hope Phil can find the perfect balance.

programs.title: The Equalizer
programs.desc: Thriller. Denzel Washington stars as an ex-soldier who comes out of retirement to help a teenage sex worker who's been assaulted by her pimp.

programs.title: Moon
programs.desc: Psychological sci-fi thriller. Sam Rockwell stars as a man who lives alone on the moon overseeing a mining operation. His time's nearly done, but he's started to go a bit peculiar..

programs.title: Travel Man: 48 Hours in Washington DC
programs.desc: Joe Lycett and Phil Wang enjoy DC's wonders, from the Washington Monument to the Barbie Pond, a secret door experience, a donut tour and a gin rickey in a speakeasy.

programs.title: Taskmaster
programs.desc: Coconuts are doused in vinegar, glue and Alex Horne's hair. Kumail Nanjiani shows off his super-human jaw strength. And don't be alarmed, it's just Joanna Page screaming... again.
